MENTOR: Good choice: Tile, Caption and Stamp will be our group in Mentor Practice 2.

I grabbed a frame at 0 s, but it came back too small for me to make out the layers, so I won't describe where they sit.

**The idea:** when one layer is the parent of others, it passes its Position, Scale and Rotation down to them. Each child still runs its own animation on top of that. A **null** is an invisible layer whose whole job is to be that parent. You place it where the group should turn or scale from, parent the group to it, and animate only the null. Your comp already has one: Hatch follows Hatch Rig.

Two things to keep in mind:
- **Children get Position, Scale and Rotation from the parent, but not Opacity or effects.** A fade on the parent won't reach them.
- **A null never shows up in the render,** so it can't add any look of its own to the group.

**Your turn:** add a null with **Layer > New > Null Object**. Before you drag it anywhere, tell me where the group should turn or scale from. It could be a corner, the middle of an edge, or the middle of the group. If the group will only slide, "it'll only slide" is a fine answer.
